video_title: Alonzo Mourning on Raising a Teenage Player

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of hard work for success
quotes.excerpt: hard work doesn't guarantee you anything, but without it, you don't stand a chance
quotes.quote: Coach Riley would always say, hard work doesn't guarantee you anything, but without it, you don't stand a chance. That's where it starts.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the necessity of being a little crazy to be great
quotes.excerpt: you've got to be a little, you know, off your rocker. You've got to be a little crazy
quotes.quote: You've got to be, yes, you've got to be a little, you know, off your rocker. You've got to be a little crazy.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the reality of facing setbacks in a career
quotes.excerpt: you've got to get punched in the face. You've got to get knocked down a little bit
quotes.quote: You've got to get punched in the face. You've got to get knocked down a little bit. It happened to me, and I'm going to tell you when it happened to me.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of shared values in team culture
quotes.excerpt: we built our organization around shared beliefs, habits, practices, thoughts, you name it, it's all shared
quotes.quote: Culture is a word that's kind of used loosely. If you don't embrace it, we've embraced it. We really have. And we built our organization around shared beliefs, habits, practices, thoughts, you name it, it's all shared, one voice, everybody speaking the same language.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on maintaining focus and avoiding hidden agendas
quotes.excerpt: the main thing remains the main thing and no hidden agendas get in the way
quotes.quote: Understanding that the main thing remains the main thing and no hidden agendas get in the way of that, and everybody coming in and doing their job, simple as that.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the value of hard work and making yourself uncomfortable
quotes.excerpt: going above and beyond, making yourself uncomfortable to the point where you're pushing yourself
quotes.quote: Really working hard, going above and beyond, making yourself uncomfortable to the point where you're pushing yourself to a level of uncomfortableness. That's what I did, and I think my efforts were contagious because it filtered to all my teammates, because they saw me doing it.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on how Pat Riley established the Heat culture
quotes.excerpt: we were able to establish that culture because Coach Riley bought me in in 1995
quotes.quote: We were able to establish that culture because Coach Riley bought me in in 1995. He shared with me what he was trying to build, and I understood the importance of it because I wasn't too far from something similar to that at Georgetown University with Coach Thompson and his overall beliefs of hard work.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on how Muggsy Bogues mentored him early in his career
quotes.excerpt: Muggsy Bogues, he kind of took me under his wing, being the smallest player in the history
quotes.quote: Muggsy Bogues, he kind of took me under his wing, being the smallest player in the history of the game, taking me under his wing and getting me to think the right way out there on the court, utilizing my strength at the time, which was my speed.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on Steph Curry's impact on the game of basketball
quotes.excerpt: I think he really revolutionized the game of basketball for us, stretching the court, really opening up
quotes.quote: I think he really revolutionized the game of basketball for us, stretching the court, really opening up the court, and so many teams kind of follow suit with those Golden State teams and how well they played in such a long period of time.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of repetition and hard work
quotes.excerpt: nothing can replace the repetition, playing on a regular basis, nothing can replace that
quotes.quote: Nothing can replace the repetition, playing on a regular basis, nothing can replace that. I mean, playing on a regular basis, nothing can replace that.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on Steph Curry's dedication to his craft
quotes.excerpt: every day, he would make 500 shots a day. That's a lot of shots
quotes.quote: Steph Curry talked about making 500 shots a day. That's a lot of shots. You've got to have somebody shag the ball for you. You've got to have it planned out. You can't do it alone.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the difficulty of being a parent and seeking help
quotes.excerpt: being a parent is extremely difficult. I have three children of my own
quotes.quote: Being a parent is extremely difficult. I have three children of my own, and I know how hard it is to be a parent when still all the information that your kids need, sometimes you need help, and there's nothing wrong with outsourcing and identifying somebody else that can help your child.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of learning from mentors
quotes.excerpt: I praise you for taking the knowledge that you gained through listening to me over the years
quotes.quote: I praise you for taking the knowledge that you gained through listening to me over the years, to being, writing, taking down mental notes from what you've been exposed to all your life, in college, and greatness of John Thompson, and listening to him, and picking Pat Riley's brain, times you had a chance.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of preparation and healthy fear
quotes.excerpt: there was a certain level of healthy fear that I experienced, and that healthy fear really was
quotes.quote: There was a certain level of healthy fear that I experienced, and that healthy fear really was built on not being prepared. And I use this analogy quite a bit when I speak to children, have you ever walked into a classroom, know that you had a test to take, and you didn't study for it? How did that make you feel?

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of preparation for success
quotes.excerpt: I took my craft seriously because I knew that every NBA game was a test
quotes.quote: I took my craft seriously because I knew that every NBA game was a test. It was like me walking into a classroom. So I didn't leave it to chance. I got prepared for every game. Every game, I put in the work the day before, I watched film, I got to the arena early, got stretched, got my body ready.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of developing a mentality of greatness
quotes.excerpt: you're developing a mentality of greatness, but you've got to be willing to do that stuff
quotes.quote: You're developing a mentality of greatness, but you've got to be willing to do that stuff. It's not a bunch of talk. You've got to be willing to really want to do that. When Kobe Bryant talks about, God rest his soul, and he talks about the work that he put in, that's the type of work that you're striving towards greatness.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of branding and NL for young athletes
quotes.excerpt: these kids are thinking about branding before they have even, they haven't even accomplished anything
quotes.quote: These kids are thinking about branding before they have even, they haven't even accomplished anything. Unfortunately, they don't have the mentality that MJ had. MJ was like, you win first, then you sell the shoes.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of managing NIL and making smart investments
quotes.excerpt: I think it needs to be managed a little bit better. I don't like the fact that somebody
quotes.quote: I think it needs to be managed a little bit better. I don't like the fact that somebody can play for four different universities in four years. I think that's messy. I think it's very transactional.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of smart work and recovery
quotes.excerpt: it's not always about hard work, it's about smart work that gets you to where you want
quotes.quote: It's not always about hard work, it's about smart work that gets you to where you want to be, because you've been on me about getting my rest every night. You've been on me about eating the right foods.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of investing in one's body
quotes.excerpt: your body is your business, so when you look at it from that perspective, your body is your business
quotes.quote: You are the CEO of your company. Your company is your body. So when you look at it from that perspective, your body is your business. So when you look at it from that perspective, your body is your business, then CEOs of companies have to make the right investment.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the importance of recovery for athlete longevity
quotes.excerpt: I really feel like that would have increased my longevity as an athlete.
quotes.quote: I really feel like that would have increased my longevity as an athlete. Because there were moments that I just, we talked about this before, that I felt like the best way for me to handle a certain situation is to take a painkiller to get back out there and play. I was ignorant to the other options.

quotes.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
quotes.summary_phrase: Alonzo Mourning on the dangers of relying on painkillers
quotes.excerpt: I had trainers that introduced me to anti-inflammatories that I pretty much relied on for the rest of my career.
quotes.quote: Instead of me leaning on those other options, I had trainers that introduced me to anti-inflammatories that I pretty much relied on for the rest of my career. So if I had one thing to tell myself, my younger self, learn better ways of helping your body recover.

quotes.speaker: Tremble
quotes.summary_phrase: Tremble on Alonzo Mourning's resilience throughout his 16-year NBA career
quotes.excerpt: I mean you still had a 16-year NBA career, which is amazing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tremble
text_blocks.text: I think it's amazing too because you're still somebody who with the right mentality, and I think gratitude is a big part of that. You had a kidney transplant, we didn't have time to necessarily talk about that today, but I mean you still had a 16-year NBA career, which is amazing. You fought through some tremendous adversity with resilience, which is the name of your book ironically.

text_blocks.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
text_blocks.text: Amen to that, man. By the way, that book Resilience, it's a teaching tool. I wrote it to inspire others to take a different approach to their overall life. When tragedy strikes, when obstacles come in your life, don't succumb to them, overcome.

quotes.speaker: Tremble
quotes.summary_phrase: Tremble on Alonzo Mourning's career peak and kidney disease diagnosis
quotes.excerpt: You were at the peak of your career, MVP candidate, defensive player of the year.

text_blocks.speaker: Tremble
text_blocks.text: You can get through anything in life with the grace of God. When you were diagnosed with kidney disease, you were just one a gold medal in Sydney. You were at the peak of your career, MVP candidate, defensive player of the year, and it was just kind of swept out under your feet.

text_blocks.speaker: Alonzo Mourning
text_blocks.text: Gratitude is so important within that process of you realizing, hey, I've been given so much, and I'm not giving it to just enjoy it myself, I'm giving it to use it as a tool to bless other people.
